news.headline: How Insurers Can Reduce Claims Cycle Time Without Losing the Human Touch
Transparent AI: Changing How You Review Documentation

paragraphs: CLIPr sells a conversational intelligence platform that converts live or recorded interactions into structured data and tailored reports. The main pitch is to loss adjusters, who can hold a natural conversation with a claimant while compliant claim reports are written automatically. The site also lists insurance, fire and EMS, law enforcement, social work and government among the sectors it addresses.

For investigations, a user uploads interview room audio or video and gets a first-draft report back within minutes for review. Interviews are transcribed automatically with speaker identification, so the record shows who said what. Summaries are produced and key moments are flagged. Search tools let a user browse by topic, jump to specific exchanges or search keywords across a whole interview. Truth score detection is offered as an optional add-on.

The company says the product fits alongside existing records and evidence management systems rather than replacing them. It also says the platform is compatible with all interview room systems. For claims teams, the site advertises a free 15 day pilot for up to 20 adjusters.

quote.text: CLIPr's search tools let you browse by topic, jump to specific exchanges, or search keywords across the entire interview in seconds.
